node commands require the ROS workspace. Use `ros2 run PACKAGE COMMAND`
for ROS installs; use `COMMAND --help` for offline CLI options.

## MuJoCo subcommands

The options below come from each subparser at runtime; no engine is started.

### robot_test export

```text
usage: robot_test export [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--config CONFIG]
                         [--payload PAYLOAD] [--timestep TIMESTEP]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        MJCF for export; JSON report otherwise
  --config CONFIG
  --payload PAYLOAD
  --timestep TIMESTEP
```

### robot_test check

```text
usage: robot_test check [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--config CONFIG]
                        [--payload PAYLOAD] [--samples SAMPLES] [--seed SEED]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        MJCF for export; JSON report otherwise
  --config CONFIG
  --payload PAYLOAD
  --samples SAMPLES
  --seed SEED
```

### robot_test simulate

```text
usage: robot_test simulate [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--config CONFIG]
                           [--payload PAYLOAD] [--timestep TIMESTEP]
                           [--duration DURATION] [--pose POSE]
                           [--target TARGET] [--max-error MAX_ERROR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        MJCF for export; JSON report otherwise
  --config CONFIG
  --payload PAYLOAD
  --timestep TIMESTEP
  --duration DURATION
  --pose POSE
  --target TARGET       named target pose; omit for a holding test
  --max-error MAX_ERROR
```

### robot_test smoke

```text
usage: robot_test smoke [-h] [--output OUTPUT] [--timestep TIMESTEP]
                        [--duration DURATION] [--keyframe KEYFRAME]
                        model

positional arguments:
  model                 MJCF model, including branched/floating-base robots

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
                        MJCF for export; JSON report otherwise
  --timestep TIMESTEP
  --duration DURATION
  --keyframe KEYFRAME
```

## General robot pipeline subcommands

Use a versioned project manifest; legacy arm commands retain their original input.

### robot_pipeline build

```text
usage: robot_pipeline build [-h] [--output OUTPUT] project

positional arguments:
  project

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
```

### robot_pipeline analyze

```text
usage: robot_pipeline analyze [-h] [--output OUTPUT] project

positional arguments:
  project

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
```

### robot_pipeline reference-check

```text
usage: robot_pipeline reference-check [-h] [--output OUTPUT] project

positional arguments:
  project

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
```

### robot_pipeline simulate

```text
usage: robot_pipeline simulate [-h] [--output OUTPUT] --scenario SCENARIO
                               [--benchmark]
                               [--benchmark-robot BENCHMARK_ROBOT]
                               [--reference REFERENCE] [--save]
                               project

positional arguments:
  project

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
  --scenario SCENARIO
  --benchmark
  --benchmark-robot BENCHMARK_ROBOT
  --reference REFERENCE
  --save
```

### robot_pipeline replay

```text
usage: robot_pipeline replay [-h] [--output OUTPUT] --trajectory TRAJECTORY
                             [--benchmark] [--benchmark-robot BENCHMARK_ROBOT]
                             [--reference REFERENCE] [--save]
                             project

positional arguments:
  project

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
  --trajectory TRAJECTORY
  --benchmark
  --benchmark-robot BENCHMARK_ROBOT
  --reference REFERENCE
  --save
```

### robot_pipeline compare

```text
usage: robot_pipeline compare [-h] --tolerances TOLERANCES [--output OUTPUT]
                              simulation reference

positional arguments:
  simulation
  reference

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --tolerances TOLERANCES
                        YAML mapping of metric names to absolute tolerances
  --output OUTPUT, -o OUTPUT
```
